fresh_001.legacy: Resource log not obtained; broad mechanism unresolved; supervisor invalid arguments ended rework.
fresh_001.review_driven: Obtained ENOSPC/zero free space via local baseline, supported volume exhaustion, safe occupancy/retention manual check; trigger remains unknown.

fresh_002.legacy: Obtained metrics and changes but not certificate log; generic interaction mechanism passed internally; incomplete diagnosis against criteria.
fresh_002.review_driven: Obtained expired certificate log and local controls; correct immediate mechanism and manual remote follow-up; broad local TLS refutation still unjustified, deployment timing not checked.

fresh_003.legacy: Source outage retained, no supported root cause; covered-action correction plus repeated planning; no final action.
fresh_003.review_driven: Direct failed-channel handoff, unknown cause retained; reviewed manual action plus one program recovery task; owner unresolved and changes only grouped as unavailable/unqueried.

eval_005.legacy: Correct partial with unavailable sources; two log categories failed on same channel; owner obtained but no diagnosis/action.
eval_005.review_driven: Correct partial, queried owner, one log attempt and one metric attempt; reviewed manual follow-up and two program recovery tasks; source failure not a business root cause.

eval_008.legacy: Capacity mechanism direction inferred from metrics/changes but repeated reviewer invalid references prevented review.
eval_008.review_driven: Resource log confirms capacity/eviction mechanism; no automatic expansion and no claim all login delay caused by cache; manual follow-up remains generic and repeats execution-time uncertainty despite visible change timestamp.

limitations: Previously seen synthetic development cases, one sample per arm; no holdout or independent human review.
Evidence selected by each arm differs. Call and token differences do not isolate a causal orchestration effect.
Program local baseline adds read-only calls; program recovery tasks are not model-generated or model-reviewed actions.
Broad refutation, imprecise uncertainty and generic manual follow-up persist despite internal passed status.
No naturally triggered pure revision/scope-extension branch; previous seeded controls remain separate.
Known usage includes invalid replies; billing, caching discounts and provider HTTP attempts remain unknown.
No frontend changes or rebuild, no live observation-server outage recovery or write operation, database tests skipped.
